title: 401(k) Retirement Savings Calculator with Employer Match
description: Free 401(k) calculator: enter your age, salary, contribution, employer match and expected return to estimate your balance at retirement, with 2026 IRS limits applied.
lead: Will your 401(k) be enough? Enter your age, pay, how much you save and what your employer adds, and see an estimated balance at retirement, in future dollars and in today's dollars, plus a year-by-year table.
keywords: how much will my 401k be worth
